senses.definition: A synthetic, solid, hydrocarbon-based polymer, whether thermoplastic or thermosetting.
senses.sourceDefinition: A synthetic, solid, hydrocarbon-based polymer, whether thermoplastic or thermosetting.
senses.example: Reducing plastic waste is a crucial problem for today’s environment, and whether it’s recyclable and biodegradable phone cases or sustainable fashion, there are plenty of eco-friendly products that can help you reduce your footprint.

senses.definition: (colloquial, metonymic) Credit or debit cards used in place of cash to buy goods and services.
senses.sourceDefinition: (colloquial, metonymic) Credit or debit cards used in place of cash to buy goods and services.
senses.example: I knew the war between cash and credit cards was over and plastic had won, hands down, when even Mickey D's started taking credit and debit cards.

senses.definition: (figurative, slang) Insincerity; fakeness; a person who is fake or arrogant, or believes that they are better than the rest of the population; a narcissistic, affected person.

senses.definition: (slang, countable) An instance of plastic surgery.
senses.sourceDefinition: (slang, countable) An instance of plastic surgery.
senses.example: Somebody's had a plastic done on his nose, I think, or else somebody bent it out of shape since I last saw it.

senses.sourceDefinition: Capable of being moulded; malleable, flexible, pliant.

senses.sourceDefinition: (biology) Capable of adapting to varying conditions; characterized by environmental adaptability.

senses.definition: Of or pertaining to the inelastic, non-brittle, deformation of a material.
senses.sourceDefinition: Of or pertaining to the inelastic, non-brittle, deformation of a material.

senses.definition: (figurative, derogatory) Inferior or not the real thing.
senses.sourceDefinition: (figurative, derogatory) Inferior or not the real thing.

senses.definition: (figurative, informal, of a person) Fake, insincere, especially in a shallow and conformist way pretending to smoothness and glossy flawlessness.
senses.sourceDefinition: (figurative, informal, of a person) Fake, insincere, especially in a shallow and conformist way pretending to smoothness and glossy flawlessness.
senses.example: He kissed the white woman once, and it was so artificial, so plastic (that's the word, plastic) that one wondered why did they bother at all.

senses.definition: (informal, birdwatching, of an individual bird) Escaped from captivity, rather than wild.
senses.sourceDefinition: (informal, birdwatching, of an individual bird) Escaped from captivity, rather than wild.
senses.example: A superb — and apparently wild, not plastic — Baikal Teal was located at RSPB Greylake in Somerset[.]

senses.definition: (informal, birdwatching, of a species or individual bird) Introduced, rather than native or naturally vagrant.
senses.sourceDefinition: (informal, birdwatching, of a species or individual bird) Introduced, rather than native or naturally vagrant.
senses.example: I was checking into my motel while a Red-whiskered Bulbul called outside – a Queensland plastic rarity which was somewhat amusing.
